title: Fix Brepjs Export Error
description: Investigate Vite runtime error: requested module brepjs.js does not provide an export named getCachedShapeKind at spatial/js/renderer-r3f index.ts:22. Explain root cause and likely fix without broad code changes.
summary: Fixed the Vite brepjs missing export by replacing the non-public root import of getCachedShapeKind with public brepjs describe aliased as describeBrepShape, preserving cached shape-kind behavior without importing a non-exported symbol. Verified no remaining getCachedShapeKind references under spatial/js and forced a fresh @spatial/js-renderer-r3f Vite build successfully. @spatial/js-kernel-brepjs:test still fails in existing cell-complex decomposition tests unrelated to the import error.
